title: Windows and WSL
summary: The native Windows installer uses uv-managed Python 3.12+; macOS/Linux remain 3.11+. --wsl teaches the separate Ubuntu route. Status, path doctor and uninstall report persistent user PATH and retain uv-owned entries. Native Windows acceptance and support remain pending. Shared platform owners handle process custody, links and file locks; POSIX uid access refuses explicitly on native Windows. Live browser identities require a symlink or junction rather than a copied profile.
